visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a green and white striped oversized shirt and a dark grey top underneath stands against a neutral indoor background. She holds up two light beige or khaki-colored fabric bags, one more rectangular and one more square, gesturing towards them with a bright expression. (2) The camera focuses on the rectangular bag as the woman's hands demonstrate its expandability by unzipping a middle section, making the bag taller. She points to a small 'kakaii' brand tag on the side. (3) Detailed shots show the interior of the bag, which includes a mesh pocket on the lid and a removable flat insert with several compartments. She places makeup brushes into specific slots covered by a transparent plastic flap to prevent staining. (4) The woman demonstrates the use of two removable Velcro dividers to create custom-sized sections within the main compartment. She populates these sections with various items, including a round cushion compact, several long tubes, and bottles of hair care products like hairspray and styling powder. (5) Throughout the remainder of the video, she shows different ways to organize the bag for different travel durations, showing it packed full and expanded, then removing items and zipping it down to a more compact form. She concludes by holding the bag and the dividers while smiling at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional showcase for a versatile cosmetic bag from the brand kakaii. It aims to highlight the product's unique selling points, such as its expandability, waterproof material, and highly customizable interior with removable Velcro dividers and brush slots. By demonstrating how the bag can be adapted for different storage needs and travel lengths, the presenter appeals to viewers looking for organized and stylish travel solutions.
